questions.question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs would make the given equation correct?

8 − 4 + 144 ÷ 16 × 27 = 14
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

**Given equation:**

8 − 4 + 144 ÷ 16 × 27 = 14

We will test each option by interchanging the specified signs and then evaluating the e×pression using the BODMAS/PEMDAS rule.

**1) Interchanging + and ×**

New equation: 8 − 4 **×** 144 ÷ 16 **+** 27

= 8 − 4 × **__144 ÷ 16__** + 27

= 8 − **__4 × 9__** + 27

= 8 − 36 + 27

= **__-28 + 27__**

= -1 ≠ 14 (Incorrect)

**2) Interchanging − and +**

New equation: 8 **__+__** 4 **__−__** 144 ÷ 16 × 27

= 8 + 4 − **__144 ÷ 16__** × 27

= 8 + 4 − **__9 × 27__**

= 8 + 4 − 243

= **__12 − 243__**

= -231 ≠ 14 (Incorrect)

**3) Interchanging ÷ and −**

New equation: 8 **__÷__** 4 + 144 **__−__** 16 × 27

= **__8 ÷ 4__** + 144 − **__16 × 27__**

= 2 + 144 − 432

= **__146 − 432__**

= -286 ≠ 14 (Incorrect)

**4) Interchanging × and −**

New equation: 8 **__×__** 4 + 144 ÷ 16 **__−__** 27

= **__8 × 4__** + **__144 ÷ 16__** − 27

= 32 + 9 − 27

= **__41 − 27__**

= 14

**14 = 14 (Correct)**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

234 × 6 − 6 ÷ 66 + 60 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

234 × 6 − 6 ÷ 66 + 60 = ?

After interchanging the sign.

234 ÷ 6 + 6 × 66 − 60 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS/PEMDAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication from left to right, Addition/Subtraction from left to right):

= **234 ÷ 6**__ + 6 × 66 − 60

= 39 + __**6 × 66**__ − 60

= __**39 + 396**__ − 60

= __**435 − 60**__

= 375

Therefore, the value of the question mark (?) is 375.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All belts are wallets.

Some wallets are glasses.

Conclusions:

(I) Some belts are glasses.

(II) Some glasses are not wallets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

 
• All belts are wallets.
 
• Some wallets are glasses.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d09d805d6c594398edda2b745909c64e9eaa49f043c660c6c7bd1c9369d6a92.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f0ffb901323691bbdc8ba0c33817f097cfa5f1095e1f40acb9ec1bebe309c30.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some belts are glasses - **False** (There is no definite relationship between 'belts' and 'glasses'. So, the conclusion does not follow.)

II. Some glasses are not wallets - **False** (The statement "Some wallets are glasses" means there is an overlap. However, it is also possible that ALL glasses are wallets. Since this conclusion is not true in all possible scenarios, it does not logically follow.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
6 is related to 77 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 9 is related to 116. To which of the following is 11 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number × 13 - 1 = 2nd number.**

6 is related to 77

→ 6 × 13 - 1

→ 78 - 1

→ 77 = 2nd number

9 is related to 116

→ 9 × 13 - 1

→ 117 - 1

→ 116 = 2nd number

11 is related to 

→ 11 × 13 - 1

→ 143 - 1

**→ 142 = 2nd number**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
